text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Wellesley Street East, City Council approval of this report is required. Aragon Properties Ltd. is constructing a 28-storey residential condominium building at 81 Wellesley Street East. The site is located on the south side of Wellesley Street East, between Church Street and Jarvis Street. The sidewalk, bike lane and a portion of the eastbound lane on the south side of Wellesley Street East, fronting the site, are currently closed to accommodate construction staging operations for the development. City Council, at its meeting on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, approved the subject construction staging area on Wellesley Street East, from May 1, 2018 to May 1, 2019. City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the continuation of the closure of the south sidewalk on Wellesley Street East, between a point 34 metres east of Church Street and a point 19.5 metres further east, from May 1, 2021 to April 30, 2022. 2. City Council approve the continuation of the closure of the bike lane and a portion of the eastbound lane on the south side of Wellesley Street East, between a point 11 metres east of Church Street and a point 68.5 meters further east and the provision of a temporary pedestrian walkway within the closed lane, from May 1, 2021 to April 30, 2022. 3. City Council direct the applicant to continue posting a 24-hour monitored construction hotline number on the hoarding board, which must be prominently placed and legible from 20 metres and on all elevations from the construction site. 4.
